Chapter 6824: Gu Chun’S Rule

Chapter 6824: Gu Chun’s Rule

The eagle turned toward the direction of the voice and saw a figure in a black shroud. Their gender was unknown. This being seemed to be part of the darkness and was omnipresent in Stygian.

Their weapon of choice was a black scythe resting on the shoulder, looking like a death god’s weapon.

“Dark Emissary.” The eagle staggered backward.

The defenders felt the same way upon seeing the overlord from Gu Chun’s Dark Realm.

Everyone thought Dark Emissary was only a role. There might be more than one of them. They were responsible for upholding the rules and delivering punishment.

The eagle had just devoured around a hundred thousand eagles from Frenzy. As part of the alliance, this was not allowed.

Despite being an overlord, he still feared this mysterious being. After all, behind them was Immortal Emperor Gu Chun.

“Emissary, I was on the verge of death, it was a matter of survival. Please understand.” The eagle said.

“Rules are rules, no justifications or exceptions. The punishment is death.” The emissary said.

The eagle’s complexion changed several times upon hearing this, becoming undecided. There was no way he would just wait for death. However, running or fighting wouldn’t end well either.

In the best-case scenario of surviving today, Dark Realm would hunt him later.

“How do you want to die?” Dark Emissary spoke emotionlessly, instilling chills into listeners.

Meanwhile, the defenders of Golden Lamp didn’t expect this development. They have mentally prepared to fight to the death.

Some young cultivators were confused about Devouring Alliance. After all, this alliance only had dark-affinity cultivators. The existence of Gu Chun’s rule perplexed them. Moreover, it wasn’t on paper either and was strictly enforced.

“Haha, this rule is outdated, no need to follow it.” A powerful voice caused the stars to shake.

After tracing the voice, everyone saw a huge shadow with a conspicuous pair of eyes. They were enormous and glowed ghastlily. Normally, nothing could be seen in the darkness of Stygian but they were still visible.

The figure approached, revealing its true appearance - a gluttonous wolf capable of eating stars. Its fur cascaded down like heavenly waterfalls.

“Gluttonous Wolf of Fallen Ten.” The eagle was surprised to see another overlord.

He came from the gluttonous branch of the Fallen Ten. Each branch did its own thing after the death of Zhao Dachui and other leaders.

The once unified faction scattered across Stygian, not bothering to communicate. This rendered them weaker than Devouring Abyss and Gu Chun’s Dark Realm.

“What do you want, Gluttonous Wolf?” Dark Emissary asked.

“I’m just telling you that this rule is outdated, Stygian will be enjoying a new age not under the rule of Dark Realm. There’s no need to follow it anymore.” The wolf said.

“I support this wholeheartedly.” The eagle immediately chimed in.
